clue.text: Manage to present bill to cabinet member

parts.note: a bill is a poster or advertisement, abbreviated to ad
a member of a government cabinet is a minister

explanation.surface: A government department head gets told to hand an invoice to a minister.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to present' only joins the definition to the wordplay, though it also hints at the answer's sense of handing out.
explanation.definitionFit: To administer a business or estate is to run or direct it, a synonym.

clue.text: A route I follow in Piedmont

definitions.note: the definition is a phrase locating a place, standing for the town's name

parts.note: a street is a route, abbreviated ST

explanation.surface: Directions for a road trip through north-west Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'follow' only joins the pieces to the definition. Piedmont is a region of north-west Italy, home to this town and its sparkling wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Asti is a town in the Italian region of Piedmont, famous for sparkling wine.

clue.text: Proposition to forge an exit visa

parts.note: to forge something is to make it
a pass is a permit to leave, like an exit visa

explanation.surface: Someone is approached with an offer to fake travel papers.
explanation.definitionFit: To proposition someone is to make sexual advances, an idiom for the same thing.

clue.text: Sanction withheld by a poet

parts.note: something withheld is refused, a no
to give sanction is to say yes

explanation.surface: A writer is denied official approval.
explanation.walkthrough: Alfred Noyes was an English poet, author of The Highwayman.
explanation.definitionFit: Alfred Noyes was an English poet best known for the ballad The Highwayman.

clue.text: Stock argument against displaying dash

parts.note: stock is a broth, a kind of soup
a con is an argument against, as in pros and cons

explanation.surface: A debate about stock market behaviour turns into a display of speed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'displaying' is a link word. 'dash' is a small amount, as in a dash of milk, not a sprint.
explanation.definitionFit: A soupcon is a tiny quantity or trace, as a pinch or dash is.

clue.text: State railway usually runs it

explanation.surface: A national railway's regular service.
explanation.definitionFit: To express is to put into words; an express is a fast train that railways run.

clue.text: Partially cook raw vegetable

indicators.note: Partially says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A kitchen tip: half-cook a vegetable rather than serve it raw.
explanation.definitionFit: Okra is a green pod eaten as a vegetable, also called ladies' fingers.

clue.text: Where the Japanese could relocate from Tokyo

indicators.note: relocate means the letters of the following word are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: A suggestion that Japanese people might move out of their capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' joins the anagram fodder to its indicator. The definition is cryptic: a place where Japanese people live.
explanation.definitionFit: Kyoto is a Japanese city, the old imperial capital, so a place where Japanese people are.

clue.text: Fighting in the van

explanation.surface: Troops in combat lead the advance.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers fighting are at the battle line; the van (vanguard) is the leading part of an army.

clue.text: Nutty biscuits

explanation.surface: Biscuits flavoured with nuts.
explanation.definitionFit: Crackers means mad, as nutty does; crackers are also thin dry biscuits.

clue.text: A sweet white wine for Catherine

parts.note: a gift for someone is given to them
Kay is a short form of the name Catherine

explanation.surface: A bottle of dessert wine is set aside as a present for Catherine.
explanation.definitionFit: Tokay is a sweet Hungarian dessert wine, an example of the type.

clue.text: Chief gives order to support me

indicators.note: giving order to jumbled words means rearranging their letters

explanation.surface: A boss instructs someone to back them up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gives order to' looks like a boss commanding, but it tells you to rearrange SUPPORT ME.
explanation.definitionFit: Uppermost means highest or foremost, as chief does.

clue.text: Butcher offers service and unusual care

parts.note: Mass is a church service

indicators.note: unusual means the word care is rearranged into another form

explanation.surface: A butcher's shop advertises its service and unusually good care.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' turns CARE into ACRE. 'offers' and 'and' are link words. 'Butcher' is a verb here.
explanation.definitionFit: To massacre is to kill brutally in large numbers, to slaughter.

clue.text: Divided a small bulb

explanation.surface: A small bulb split into segments.
explanation.definitionFit: Clove is a past tense of cleave, to split; a clove is a segment of a bulb such as garlic.

clue.text: Not even dons can form a secret brotherhood

parts.note: a number that is not even is odd
dons are university teachers, also called fellows

explanation.surface: Academics form an odd secret society.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can form' is a link. The Oddfellows are a friendly society with secret rituals.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oddfellows are a fraternal friendly society with secret rites, a mutual-aid fraternity.

clue.text: They're late gathering the remains of a drinking party

definitions.text: the remains of a drinking party

explanation.surface: Latecomers collect the bottles after a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gathering' is a link. 'late' means deceased, and dead men is slang for empty bottles.
explanation.definitionFit: The late are those who have died; empty bottles left after drinking are slang dead men.

clue.text: Sheet anchor needed for a stop at sea

parts.note: the main is an old word for the open sea
to stay is to stop in a place

explanation.surface: A ship needs a heavy anchor to halt out at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needed for a' and 'at' are links. A sheet anchor is a large spare anchor, figuratively a chief support.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheet anchor is a ship's emergency anchor and so a chief support, which is a mainstay.

clue.text: Spare dollars given to creditor

parts.note: S is short for dollars, from the dollar sign
a creditor is someone who lends money, a lender

explanation.surface: Spare cash in dollars handed to someone owed money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'given to' is a link. 'Spare' means thin, not extra.
explanation.definitionFit: Spare can mean lean or thin, as a slender person is.

clue.text: Conrad novel Scotsman finds most severe

definitions.note: a superlative phrase defining an adjective meaning extremely harsh

indicators.note: novel as an adjective means new, so the letters of Conrad take a new order

parts.note: Ian is a typical Scottish man's name

explanation.surface: A Scottish reader judges a Joseph Conrad novel to be very harsh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' turns CONRAD into DRACON. 'finds' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Draconian laws are excessively harsh, after Draco the Athenian lawgiver.

clue.text: Quick gin sling — but definitely no food!

parts.note: fast means quick

indicators.note: sling suggests tossing the word gin so that its letters land jumbled

explanation.surface: A quick gin cocktail, but nothing at all to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: A gin sling is a cocktail, but here 'sling' rearranges GIN to ING. 'but' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Fasting is going without eating, abstaining entirely from meals.

clue.text: Celebration meal for sculpture

parts.note: a gala is a festive celebration
tea is a meal, especially a light afternoon one

explanation.surface: A party dinner is arranged in honour of a statue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link. In Greek myth Galatea was the ivory statue carved by Pygmalion that came to life.
explanation.definitionFit: Galatea is the statue Pygmalion carved, a sculpture in Greek legend.

clue.text: America is in disgrace, and needs support

indicators.note: is in places the country inside the word for disgrace

parts.note: a stain on one's reputation is a disgrace

explanation.surface: A political commentary: America, in disgrace, needs its allies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and needs' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To sustain is to hold up or keep going, a synonym of support.

clue.text: Succeeded in getting ar tournament player to accept dog

indicators.note: accepting means the seed takes the dog inside it

parts.note: a seed is a ranked player in a tournament
a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: A top-ranked tennis player agrees to take in a stray dog.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed 'ar' is a scan error for 'a'.
explanation.definitionFit: To have secured something is to have obtained it, managed to get it.

clue.text: Hair-fasteners

explanation.surface: Clips that hold hair in place.
explanation.definitionFit: Locks are tresses of hair; locks are also devices that fasten doors.

clue.text: Some of them raced around the tree

indicators.note: Some of says only part of the following words is used, a run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: Some of the runners circled the tree during the race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' looks like an anagram signal for RACED, but the tree runs straight through 'raced around'.
explanation.definitionFit: The cedar is a large coniferous tree, an example of one.

clue.text: Spot calcium in moisturising cream

indicators.note: in puts the chemical symbol inside the word for the cream

parts.note: a lotion is a moisturising cream
Ca is the chemical symbol for calcium

explanation.surface: A blemish treated with calcium in a skin cream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spot' means a place, not a pimple.
explanation.definitionFit: A location is a place or site, as a spot is.

clue.text: He gives instruction on 8 cooking trout

definitions.note: 8 refers to 8-down, so this reads as someone teaching from the head of the class

indicators.note: cooking means the word trout is worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A chef demonstrates how to cook fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 points to 8-down, a phrase for the head of the room, where a teacher stands.
explanation.definitionFit: A tutor is a teacher who gives lessons, standing before the class.

clue.text: Examines experienced US soldiers

explanation.surface: Old American troops are checked over.
explanation.definitionFit: To vet is to check thoroughly; vets is American slang for veterans, seasoned former soldiers.

clue.text: A work of art seldom created

indicators.note: created means these letters are made into something new

explanation.surface: A remark that genuine art is rarely produced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is a link. 'created' rearranges ART SELDOM.
explanation.definitionFit: An old master is a painting by a great European artist of the past, a celebrated painting.

clue.text: Skip English? Nonsense!

parts.note: to skip is to trip lightly along

explanation.surface: A pupil asks to miss the English lesson and is rebuked.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripe is slang for rubbish or worthless talk.

clue.text: Agile agent captures ringleader

indicators.note: captures means the spy holds the letter inside

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
read as ring leader, the leading letter of ring

explanation.surface: A nimble secret agent arrests the head of a gang.
explanation.definitionFit: Spry means lively and active, nimble.

clue.text: Travels west and east to get jewellery

parts.note: rings are items of jewellery

explanation.surface: A traveller goes in both directions to buy jewellery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Wanderings are journeys or roamings, as travels are.
